text: ポケモンセンターに　あずけると　つかれて　うごけない　ポケモンも　げんきに　なるよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンセンターに　あずけると
structure.en: if you leave them at a Pokémon Center

structure.jp: つかれて　うごけない　ポケモンも
structure.en: even Pokémon too tired to move

patterns.name: 〜と (conditional)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says 'whenever that happens, this follows'. あずけると = 'if you leave them'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つかれて　うごけない
patterns.explanation: て-form joins to the next part and can give a reason. つかれて うごけない = 'too tired to move'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に plus なる means to become something. げんきに なる = 'become well'.
